snippet.title: Tiny Terra Spaces - Steam page announcement trailer | Ludus Pax Studios
snippet.description:
Hello everyone!

I am a solo game developer running my own solo game development studio based in Scotland. I have completed my degree in Computer Games Development with a first classification. 
In this video I am discussing the announcement that now Tiny Terra Spaces is ready to be wishlisted on Steam! 

BIG ANNOUNCEMENT!
✨ Tiny Terra Spaces is now live on Steam for wishlisting! ✨
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3788070/Tiny_Terra_Spaces/
Hit that Wishlist button to support the game!
🎥 Check out the brand-new announcement trailer below!
#indiegame #cosygame #cosybuilder #cosyindiegame #solodev #madewithunity

🎮 Welcome to Ludus Pax Studios!
I’m Silviu, a solo indie developer making cosy, creative, and meaningful games. Discover my projects below, try a demo, support development, or join the community!

🌱 Now Playing: Tiny Terra Spaces
My cosy building game — shape your island, expand with charm, and decorate with a curated selection of buildings.

▶️ Play the Game Jam Demo on Itch.io
https://ludus-pax-studio.itch.io/tiny-terra-spaces
💖 Support with a purchase or donation to help fund future development!

⚔️ Rise of the Village Hero – Indie RPG Adventure
Fight, grow, and lead in a rich fantasy world.

📜 Press release & website:
https://luduspaxstudios.uk/index.php/home/rise-of-the-village-hero-press-release/

🎥 Watch Gameplay:
https://youtu.be/oIUTnOvdQWA?si=Mx1Zjb8CBWwNAYsD
https://youtu.be/tT4Fk1VT3y8?si=ilYyYcliLHkBMUTV
https://youtu.be/zzpLZtzusXI?si=XWrTSgNv3_1JIPcN
https://youtu.be/QL_XPmgwLwQ?si=LwzPyIYXzlVqp-aJ
https://youtu.be/6d7sK9UJscE?si=1ReiaCaxoUNheCQp

🛍️ Get the game:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2737960/Rise_of_the_Village_Hero/
Itch.io: https://ludus-pax-studio.itch.io/rise-of-the-village-hero
Humble Store: https://www.humblebundle.com/store/rise-of-the-village-hero

🌄 Path to Serenity – A Cosy Walking Sim (Coming Soon)
Explore a peaceful world at your own pace. Wishlist now!

📺 Trailer:
https://youtu.be/JqA8oW5N8Fk

📜 Press release & assets:
https://luduspaxstudios.uk/index.php/home/path-to-serenity-press-release/

🎥 Watch gameplay:
https://youtu.be/h8xZwJGXRds?si=J1a58utD3NAGb1Ll
https://youtu.be/jfkznHbVRyI?si=IdJ7oIOzr2BgI0s_
https://youtu.be/F4eM0MXiK3g?si=-FbutG9iNXsokk9q
https://youtu.be/BfPMuz9zRPY?si=vkkl3aQACkVR2Px1
https://youtu.be/AbGbroKID8E?si=6FtA-cs3-zSjsodU

🛍️ Get the game:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3265030/Path_to_Serenity/
Itch.io: https://ludus-pax-studio.itch.io/path-to-serenity
Humble Store: https://www.humblebundle.com/store/path-to-serenity

🔨 Rusty Hammer – Cosy Blacksmith Idler
A relaxing blacksmith game, free to play now on Itch.io (download + WebGL)

▶️ Try it now:
https://ludus-pax-studio.itch.io/rusty-hammer

💖 Support with a donation if you enjoyed it!

☕ Support the Studio
If you enjoy my work and want to help me continue making indie games:

🧡 Patreon: https://patreon.com/LudusPaxStudios
☕ Ko-fi: https://ko-fi.com/silviulatuduspaxstudios

📢 Follow & Join the Community
👾 Discord: https://discord.gg/yXjcugshQz
🐦 Twitter/X: https://twitter.com/LudusPaxStudio
📸 Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/luduspaxstudio/
💬 Threads: https://www.threads.net/@luduspaxstudio
🌐 BlueSky: https://bsky.app/profile/luduspaxstudios.bsky.social
🌍 Website: https://luduspaxstudios.uk/

🔔 Don't forget to like, comment, and subscribe!
Your support helps me keep creating cosy, original games. Thanks so much for watching!

#cosygame #indiedev #indiegame #walkingSimulator #rpg #gamedev #itchio #steam #cosygaming
